patches.title: Clean Objects From Trash
patches.principle: If target not on open surfaces, check garbage cans—they may contain the object.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target is not on countertops, tables, or shelves.

patches.title: Direct Path After Clean
patches.principle: After cleaning the object, go straight to the destination and place it without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after the clean action succeeds.

patches.title: Clean on Sink Only
patches.principle: Always use the sinkbasin to clean objects; no other surface or tool suffices.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning an object.
